overall_summary: The channel has a very small dataset with low view counts overall (under 40 views per video). Videos centered around 'self respect' and smartphone-related micro-habits (like deleting chats or numbers) show slightly better engagement comparatively, but overall sample size is too low to establish a definitive viral formula. A controlled exploration approach is required.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (36 views) and 'बिना नाम का नंबर' (24 views) outperformed generic emotional hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible smartphone or digital communication gestures rather than abstract feelings.

winning_patterns.evidence: The 'self respect' topic cluster generally attracts slightly higher initial traction than general heartbreak.
winning_patterns.action: Anchor heartbreak or overthinking stories into choices of personal dignity and boundary-setting.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय' (5 views) resulted in lower engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night or tea-drinking cliches; use specific physical actions instead.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad titles mentioning general sadness underperformed compared to specific action-oriented scenarios.
weak_patterns.action: Ensure titles and hooks reference a precise, highly relatable digital dilemma.
